fontes.raw: Ex cod. Vindobon. theol. 277. saec. XII vel XIII.

heads.la: INCIPIT ORDO AD REGEM BENEDICENDUM, QUANDO NOVUS A CLERO ET POPULO SUBLIMATUR IN REGNUM.
heads.en: HERE BEGINS THE ORDER FOR BLESSING THE KING, WHEN A NEW ONE IS RAISED BY THE CLERGY AND PEOPLE INTO THE KINGSHIP.[n: (Ex cod. Vindobon. theol. 277. saec. XII vel XIII.)]
